mechanism_narrative: A positive quarterly growth in real GDP (GDPC1) indicates robust economic expansion, which typically leads to higher corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 growth is positive (relative to the historical average of positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as higher borrowing costs dampen economic activity and equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in employment (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment (UNRATE) signals a strong labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days. The interaction is critical because a single series might not capture the full labor market strength.
failure_condition: The interaction effect (PAYEMS increase and UNRATE decrease) fails to produce positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply-constrained regime (indicated by INDPRO below 100), manufacturing output contraction leads to higher inflation expectations and reduced corporate margins, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: A rising monthly CPI (CPIAUCSL) indicates accelerating inflation, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as central banks may tighten policy and erode real earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL rises month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: When monthly housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1000.0 thousand units, it signals strong consumer demand for housing and related sectors, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 1000.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in real GDP (GDPC1) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates broad-based economic strength, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days. The interaction is necessary because a single series might not capture the full economic momentum.
failure_condition: The interaction effect (GDPC1 growth and RSAFS increase) fails to produce positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 235.0), rising inflation expectations lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as central banks accelerate rate hikes.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 235.0.
